Self-driving cars communicate to their passengers using natural language processing and 
voice recognition.
For example, a passenger could say, “Take me home via the scenic route,” and the natural 
language processing should correctly interpret this instruction.
(d) (i)   Identify a noun in this instruction. [1]
(ii) Explain the semantics of this instruction. [4]
The passenger could also use natural language to check the grammar of messages sent 
from the self-driving car. The model would suggest and include missing words.
For example, “I late. Don’t wait me,” might be interpreted as, “I am late. Don’t wait for me.”
(e) Compare voice recognition with natural language grammar checking using neural 
network modelling. [6]
